1.consolidated_definition: Gratis. Se dice de lo que no cuesta nada. Posible neologismo anglicado, frecuente. Este espectáculo teatral, musical, bailable, inspirado en la poesía de Don Francisco Arriví será libre de costo para el público quienes podrán obtener sus boletos a través del Programa de Teatro y Danza del Instituto de Cultura Puertorriqueña (Fundación Nacional para la Cultura Popular, 11-05-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Free. Said of something that costs nothing. Possible anglicized neologism, frequent. This theatrical, musical, and dance-inspired spectacle based on the poetry of Don Francisco Arriví will be free of charge to the public, who can obtain their tickets through the Theater and Dance Program of the Puerto Rican Institute of Culture (National Foundation for Popular Culture, 11-05-07).
